```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(dplyr)
library(DT)
library(highcharter)
library(readr)

source(here::here("R", "model-timeline.R"))

source_url <- paste0(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jbkunst/motorsport-legends/",
  "main/data/cars/nissan_heritage_collection.csv"
)

initial_model <- "Nissan R91CP"
initial_point_id <- "model_124"

source_data <- read_csv(
  source_url,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  col_select = -c(image_data_uri, thumb_data_uri)
) |>
  mutate(
    display_image_url = coalesce(.data$image_url, .data$thumb_url),
    vehicle_type_key = coalesce(.data$vehicle_type, ""),
    timeline_category = case_when(
      .data$category == "Competition" ~ "Competition",
      stringr::str_detect(
        .data$vehicle_type_key,
        stringr::regex("sedan", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) ~ "Road / Sedans",
      stringr::str_detect(
        .data$vehicle_type_key,
        stringr::regex("sport|specialty", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) ~ "Road / Sports & specialty",
      stringr::str_detect(
        .data$vehicle_type_key,
        stringr::regex("commercial|suv|minivan|wagon", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) ~ "Road / Utility & commercial",
      TRUE ~ "Road / Other"
    )
  ) |>
  select(-all_of("vehicle_type_key"))

nissan_records <- source_data |>
  transmute(
    Model = model_timeline_record_link(.data$model, .data$url),
    Photo = model_timeline_record_photo(
      .data$display_image_url,
      .data$thumb_url
    ),
    Year = .data$year,
    Category = .data$category,
    `Heritage category` = .data$heritage_category,
    Decade = .data$heritage_decade,
    `Vehicle type` = .data$vehicle_type,
    Engine = .data$engine,
    `Engine code` = .data$engine_code,
    `Displacement (cc)` = .data$displacement_cc,
    `Power (cv)` = .data$max_power_cv,
    `Power rpm` = .data$rpm_max_power,
    `Torque (Nm)` = .data$torque_nm,
    `Torque rpm` = .data$rpm_max_torque,
    `Top speed (km/h)` = .data$top_speed_kmh,
    `Weight (kg)` = .data$weight_kg,
    `Wheelbase (mm)` = .data$wheelbase_mm,
    `Length (mm)` = .data$length_mm,
    `Width (mm)` = .data$width_mm,
    `Height (mm)` = .data$height_mm,
    Description = .data$description
  )

cars <- model_timeline_adapt(
  source_data,
  mapping = list(
    id = "no",
    model = "model",
    year = "year",
    category = "timeline_category",
    description = "description",
    image_url = "display_image_url",
    tooltip_image_url = "thumb_url",
    official_url = "url"
  ),
  details = c(
    "Vehicle type" = "vehicle_type",
    "Engine" = "engine",
    "Engine code" = "engine_code",
    "Displacement (cc)" = "displacement_cc",
    "Power (cv)" = "max_power_cv",
    "Torque (Nm)" = "torque_nm",
    "Weight (kg)" = "weight_kg"
  ),
  description_fallback = ""
)
```

# [NISSAN]{.nissan-title-brand} heritage {.model-timeline-title}

::: {.model-timeline-intro}

An interactive data visualization of 393 road and competition vehicles in the [Nissan Heritage Collection](https://www.nissan-global.com/EN/HERITAGE_COLLECTION/) from 1920 to 2013, grouped into five bands by category and vehicle type. Compare engines, power, specifications, and model history.

::: {.model-timeline-chart aria-label="Interactive timeline of Nissan Heritage Collection vehicles by year and category"}

```{r}
#| label: nissan-heritage-timeline

model_timeline_chart(
  cars,
  initial_model = initial_model,
  initial_point_id = initial_point_id,
  brand = "Nissan",
  accent = "#006bb6",
  font_family = "IBM Plex Sans",
  source_url = source_url,
  category_labels = c(
    "Road / Sedans" = "Road / Sedans",
    "Road / Sports & specialty" = "Road / Sports",
    "Road / Utility & commercial" = "Road / Utility",
    "Road / Other" = "Road / Other",
    "Competition" = "Competition"
  ),
  category_order = c(
    "Road / Sedans",
    "Road / Sports & specialty",
    "Road / Utility & commercial",
    "Road / Other",
    "Competition"
  ),
  point_spacing = 0.075,
  stack_span = 0.82,
  theme = list(
    axis_label_color = "#526577",
    category_label_color = "#14324a",
    grid_line_color = "rgba(0, 74, 128, 0.12)",
    axis_line_color = "rgba(0, 74, 128, 0.24)",
    x_axis_opposite = TRUE,
    x_axis_line_width = 0,
    x_axis_tick_length = 0,
    marker_fill_color = "rgba(0, 107, 182, 0.58)",
    marker_line_color = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.90)",
    marker_active_line_color = "#ffffff",
    inactive_opacity = 0.34,
    tooltip_background_color = "#ffffff",
    tooltip_border_radius = 2,
    credits_color = "#647789"
  )
)
```
